exams.bookletScopeNote: All pages of both booklets remain searchable and all existing513 MOL1–13 source-index entries remain available. Directly cited new explained tasks are counted per file below; many additional repeated booklet tasks occur in the exam-derived adaptations. This is a curated expanded bank, not a claim that each of513 source-index entries has a distinct reviewed explanation. The source index includes repeated tasks, image labels, recalled fragments and some out-of-section questions. No source index entry is deleted. Most MOL14–26 MCQs and later metabolic SAQs remain source-only because outside the current MOL1–13 priority.
exams.adaptationPolicy: Every new graded item is labeled Past paper · adapted. Original recalled wording/source excerpt remains available. Any completed options, repaired keys, replaced missing figures and reconstructed stems are authored study aids rather than official options.
keyCorrections: Lynch syndrome: mismatch repair, not polymerase proofreading
Cotranslational order begins with translation, before SRP binding
RNA template answers require antiparallel strand labels
Protein thermostability is not explained by protein G–C base pairs
Asparagine is polar but ordinarily uncharged; the source ionic-interaction item needed a charged alternative
Cardiac amyloidosis question narrowed toATTR because light chains are also possible
Glargine: AsnA21→Gly plus two C-terminal B-chain arginines
Normal stop codons use release factors, not ordinary stop tRNA anticodons
GAG xylose linker normally attaches to serine in the specified proteoglycan context
